## Problem_1 

Importing the dataset 
```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The `penguins` dataset includes information about penguins’ species, island, sex, and year, along with measurements of bill length, bill depth, flipper length, and body mass. It contains `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables. The mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(3)` mm.
